mui.lite.title: Modern UI Lite
mui.lite.redirect: This build has no settings screen of its own. The configuration is rendered by YetAnotherConfigLib.
mui.lite.openFolder.text: Open the folder that holds the config files.
mui.lite.blurEffect.desc: Apply Gaussian blur to screens that originate from Modern UI.
mui.lite.additionalBlurEffect.desc: Apply Gaussian blur to screens that have a background and do not originate from Modern UI.
mui.lite.overrideVanillaBlur.desc: Replace the vanilla three-pass box blur with the Modern UI Gaussian blur.
mui.lite.backgroundDuration.desc: Milliseconds the screen background takes to fade in.
mui.lite.tooltip.desc: Render tooltips with the Modern UI renderer.
mui.lite.roundedTooltip.desc: Use rounded corners on the tooltip background.
mui.lite.centerTooltipTitle.desc: Center the first line of the tooltip.
mui.lite.tooltipTitleBreak.desc: Draw a separator below the tooltip title.
mui.lite.exactTooltipPositioning.desc: Place the tooltip exactly at the cursor instead of snapping it.
mui.lite.adaptiveTooltipColors.desc: Let the border color follow the item name and rarity.
mui.lite.tooltipLineWrapping.desc: Wrap tooltip lines that are wider than the screen.
mui.lite.tooltipRadius.desc: Corner radius of the tooltip background.
mui.lite.tooltipArrowScrollFactor.desc: How far an arrow key scrolls the tooltip, requires exact positioning.
mui.lite.inventoryPause.desc: Pause the single player game while the inventory is open.
mui.lite.forceRtl.desc: Force the layout direction to right-to-left instead of following the locale.
mui.lite.useNewGuiScale.desc: Use the Modern UI GUI scale implementation.
mui.lite.removeTelemetry.desc: Strip the telemetry property from the game.
mui.lite.fontScale.desc: Global scale applied to sp units.
mui.lite.framerateInactive.desc: Framerate limit while the window is not focused.
mui.lite.masterVolumeInactive.desc: Master volume multiplier while the window is not focused.
mui.lite.masterVolumeMinimized.desc: Master volume multiplier while the window is minimized.
mui.lite.globalVolumeControl.desc: Apply the volume multiplier to the global listener gain.
mui.lite.ding.desc: Play a sound when the game reaches the main menu.
mui.lite.dingSound.desc: Sound event played by the ding.
mui.lite.touchSlop.desc: Distance a touch must move before it counts as a scroll.
mui.lite.hoverSlop.desc: Distance the cursor must move before a hover event fires.
mui.lite.minScrollbarTouchTarget.desc: Smallest area that still counts as a scrollbar grab.
mui.lite.minimumFlingVelocity.desc: Velocity below which a fling is not started.
mui.lite.maximumFlingVelocity.desc: Velocity above which a fling is clamped.
mui.lite.overscrollDistance.desc: How far the content may be dragged past its bounds.
mui.lite.overflingDistance.desc: How far a fling may carry the content past its bounds.
mui.lite.hoverTooltipShowTimeout.desc: Delay before a hover tooltip appears.
mui.lite.hoverTooltipHideTimeout.desc: Delay before a hover tooltip disappears.
mui.lite.firstFontFamily.desc: Family name or path of a font file. Leave empty to pick a system font for the current language.
mui.lite.useColorEmoji.desc: Use color emoji images instead of grayscale glyphs.
mui.lite.emojiShortcodes.desc: Replace shortcodes in chat with their emoji sequence.
mui.lite.allowShadow.desc: Draw a drop shadow behind text.
mui.lite.fixedResolution.desc: Render text at a fixed resolution regardless of the GUI scale.
mui.lite.baseFontSize.desc: Font size used by the text engine for in-world text.
mui.lite.baselineShift.desc: Vertical offset applied to the text baseline.
mui.lite.shadowOffset.desc: Offset between text and its shadow.
mui.lite.cacheLifespan.desc: Seconds a cached text layout is kept.
mui.lite.useTextShadersInWorld: Use modern text shaders in world
mui.lite.useTextShadersInWorld.desc: Render in-world text through the Modern UI shaders.
mui.lite.minPixelDensityForSDF.desc: Minimum resolution level for SDF text and in-world text.
mui.lite.linearSamplingA8Atlas: Linear sampling for the A8 atlas
mui.lite.linearSamplingA8Atlas.desc: Sample the grayscale glyph atlas with bilinear filtering.
mui.lite.textDirection.desc: Direction used to lay out bidirectional text.
mui.lite.defaultFontBehavior.desc: Which glyph providers of the vanilla default font are kept.
mui.lite.lineBreakWordStyle.desc: Phrase based breaking for CJK text.
mui.lite.useComponentCache.desc: Look text layouts up by component object.
mui.lite.allowAsyncLayout.desc: Lay out text on background threads.
mui.lite.computeDeviceFontSize: Compute font size in device space
mui.lite.computeDeviceFontSize.desc: Derive the font size from the current transform matrix.
mui.lite.allowSDFTextIn2D: Allow SDF text in the 2D GUI
mui.lite.allowSDFTextIn2D.desc: Use SDF text rendering where appropriate.
mui.lite.linearMetrics.desc: Fractional glyph advances instead of whole pixels.
mui.lite.developerMode.desc: Show the debug entries and extra logging.
